title: Historical cipher target triage
scope: Research candidates and evidence acquisition; no historical decipherment claimed.
conclusion: No checked named target is established to be easy. Prefer verified archival text, known language, and keys or deciphered siblings.

priority_meaning.needs_more_evidence: Gather constraints before committing to an attack.
priority_meaning.defer: Not a quick-win target under current evidence and engine capabilities.

selection_rules: Check current firsthand outcomes, editions, key sheets and clear duplicates before interpreting catalog metadata as unsolved status.
Treat named-target tractability as an inference; do not assign numerical success probabilities.
Preserve each missing position and source conflict rather than guessing or truncating it.
Require held-out controls matched for language, length, alphabet, damage and cipher design.
Check language scoring against shuffled controls and retain ambiguous or residual unread symbols.
Document a reversible transformation and verified key before claiming a decipherment.
